newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures slide, further fall seen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures slide, further fall seen.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures slid in thin trade on Wednesday amid uncertainty over the dollar's direction, traders said.
"Bears are gaining power," said one trader at a major Japanese trading house.
"Though LME prices are strong, market participants here are worried over the yen's strength (against the dollar)," he said.
Traders said bargain-hunters did not emerge today, even though prices were moving near their contract lows.
TOCOM yen-based aluminium futures ranged from 0.5 yen to 1.4 yen per kg lower, with benchmark April 1998 closing down 1.0 yen at 200.6 yen.
Estimated trade volume was 2,578 lots, down from 3,441 lots on Tuesday. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-6179
